answer_1.quote: We evaluate VLIS on ... weirdness identification (WHOOPS) and commonsense VQA (OK-VQA, ScienceQA), extended image captioning (Concadia and Image Paragraph Captioning), and open-ended generation (ROCStories).
answer_1.outputs: generated captions, paragraph captions, story texts, VQA answers

answer_2.quote: Both captioning benchmarks use automatic text metrics, including CIDEr, METEOR, and Bleu-4. ... We use various fluency metrics (2-gram repetition, diversity, coherence, MAUVE) and a visual strength metric (CLIPScore).
